title: NASA Blue Marble: Eastern & Western Hemispheres
description: True-color satellite composite combining MODIS land surface, ocean chlorophyl, clouds, and polar ice sheets into a photorealistic planetary view.
altText: Satellite photograph of planet Earth showing blue oceans, white swirling storm cloud formations, green terrestrial vegetation, and brown arid land masses.

title: Climate Warming Stripes (1880–2025)
agency: NASA GISS / University of Reading (Prof. Ed Hawkins)
description: A visual chronometer of Earth's climate history: each vertical stripe represents one consecutive year's temperature anomaly from cool blues to extreme deep red.
altText: Visual stripe diagram starting with deep blues in 1880, pale cyans in mid-20th century, transitioning rapidly to bright orange and dark crimson bars in recent decades.

title: NASA Black Marble: Night Lights & Electrification
agency: NASA Earth Applied Sciences / Suomi NPP VIIRS
description: Global composite of nocturnal light emissions capturing human civilization, urbanization, energy grids, and coastal fishing fleets under darkness.
altText: Global satellite view of Earth at night showing golden spiderwebs of city lights across North America, Europe, East Asia, and coastlines against dark oceans.

title: Current 3D Earth Camera View (Live Frame)
description: Direct frame grab from the active interactive 3D WebGL globe, reflecting the user's selected camera angle, rotation, and current temperature glow.
altText: Current 3D rendered viewpoint of planet Earth with real-time solar illumination and data-driven atmospheric glow.
